purpose: Prevent avoidable open ends. Every unresolved item must receive one final targeted official-source sweep before it may remain in the backlog. Concept/draft instruments are retained as explicit research signals, never silently discarded.

mandatoryFinalSweep.appliesTo: all researched municipalities, retroactively and prospectively
mandatoryFinalSweep.trigger: any item still open after initial research, deepening, retest and closure search
requiredSearchLayers: official municipal council/college decisions and attachments
official executing agency/omgevingsdienst pages where municipality delegates the route

requiredFields: publication or decision date where known
difference from current law where determinable
conceptDraftPolicy.researchMeaning: A concept or draft is a positive signal that the municipality may change its rules. It should generate a follow-up item instead of being discarded or confused with an unresolved absence of law.
followUpClasses: compare final text with current law

allowedFinalOpenClasses: address/location/geometry dependent and impossible to determine without a concrete address
dynamic Omgevingsloket or live-form output that cannot be determined generically
case/exception-specific evidence that only appears after applicant choices
not further determinable after documented repeated official-source searches
known concept/draft instrument awaiting official adoption or effective date
mandatoryFinalSweep.prohibitedShortcut: Do not leave an item open merely because the first closure search did not find it. Do not discard a concept/draft merely because it is not yet current law.

batchGate: No municipality or batch is marked research-complete until every residual has either been closed by the final sweep or assigned one of the allowed final-open classes with a reason. A known concept/draft does not block generic-current-law closure if current law is established, but it must remain as a monitored research signal.
excelAndBacklogRule: Backlog and Excel synchronization occurs only after the final sweep for the municipalities concerned; concept/draft signals must be exported separately from current-law fields.
